title: Find the names of players born before 1986 who have above-average heading a
question: Find the names of players born before 1986 who have above-average heading accuracy and vision scores of at least 90. Return the top 5 players ordered by their average heading accuracy in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_125) < '1986'
  AND pa.XCL_139 > (SELECT AVG(pa2.XCL_139) FROM Player_Attributes pa2)
  AND pa.XCL_150 >= 90
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_139) DESC
LIMIT 5

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_125) < '1986'
  AND pa.XCL_133 >= 90
  AND pa.XCL_132 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa2.XCL_132)
    FROM Player p2
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON p2.XCL_122 = pa2.XCL_130
    WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p2.XCL_125) < '1986'
      AND pa2.XCL_133 >= 90
  )
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_132) DESC
LIMIT 5
